routing.reasoning: E-commerce order processing is a complex workflow with 6+ sequential steps, multiple decision points (payment verification, inventory checks), parallel processes (notifications, inventory updates), and multiple user roles. Requires advanced forms with validation, relational data model for orders/customers/products, and cross-platform mobile support for all user types. Data-processing domain due to heavy focus on order state management and inventory tracking.
